title: feat(entk14): enter-body same-k fails at k=14: t=26 vs t=46
science: The eps wall: k=14 on B_42, t=26 vs 46, 2028<2116, reverse fails. Reports the k=13 pair 25 vs 43 on the SAME Dijkstra, so the restore-then-die transition is exhibited inside one run. Together with #6807 this fixes eps's window as k=2..13 -- one scale past mu, at the cost of k=1.
